I have consistently maintained my reporting and tracking sheet by updating daily call activities, monitoring data accuracy, and ensuring that all lead stages are correctly recorded based on discussions with merchants.

For merchants who were marked as "Not Interested," I proactively reconnected with them to better understand the reasons behind their decision to discontinue using Razorpay and their reluctance to return. During these conversations, I also explored whether there were any concerns or challenges that we could address to improve their overall experience with Razorpay.

In cases where merchants remained uninterested and did not provide a specific reason for their decision, I escalated those leads to Gauri, who manages churn revival, for a second level of follow-up. This ensured that every lead was validated appropriately and that all fields in my tracking sheet were updated accurately, without any incorrect or incomplete inputs.

text:
Here's the full lineup of your Sales Copilot tooling, built up since May:

Core daily workflow

Morning triage bot ("run my bots" / "run my email bot") — pulls Gmail inbox, Calendar, and the Drive pipeline sheet in parallel, flags urgent emails, missed replies, and today's meetings. Runs off a 9am recurring calendar trigger.
EOD missed-reply sweep — same bot, evening pass at 6pm, catches anything from the day that slipped through before you log off.

Deal management bots

Stale-deal nudge bot — flags deals that have gone quiet (this is what keeps surfacing Wogom, for instance) so nothing sits untouched for weeks without you noticing.
Merchant onboarding tracker bot — tracks accounts through the activation/integration pipeline so you can see who's stuck and why.
Email reply bot — helps draft quick responses to merchant threads directly from the triage pass.

Reporting

Weekly performance summary bot — rolls up your dial/connect/GMV numbers against team and quarterly targets (the AMJ/JAS tracking you've been doing).

Pre-call prep

Pre-call brief generator — pulls context on a merchant before a scheduled call so you walk in knowing their history, not scrambling beforehand.

Sharing/scaling

Standalone deployable HTML dashboard — a version of the whole Sales Copilot dashboard (inbox, deals, calendar, pipeline tabs) that you built so Nishi and Prerna, or the wider team, could use it without going through Claude directly.
